review_evidence: Specs/AESCommon.lean and AESArm.lean define AES key schedules, SubBytes, ShiftRows, MixColumns, AddRoundKey, and encryption functions with supporting theorems.
Specs/GCM.lean and GCMV8.lean define GHASH/GCTR/GCM operations and polynomial arithmetic; Specs/SHA512*.lean defines SHA-512 schedules and compression.

Proofs/AES-GCM, Proofs/SHA512, Correctness, Arm, and Tactics contain verification conditions, symbolic execution, ISA semantics, and proved correctness material; Tests/Benchmarks also exercise formal specifications rather than constituting lossless noise.
summary: Retain LNSym as substantive formal specification and verification of ARM cryptographic code, including AES-GCM and SHA-512 semantics and correctness proofs.
